disclaimer: Independent preparation information. Always confirm current requirements on official NAATI pages before the test.
candidateRules: Interpret each segment after the chime into the other language.
Use direct speech rather than reporting what a speaker said.
One segment per dialogue may be repeated without penalty; later repeats may attract deductions.
Only pen and loose blank paper may be used for notes; electronic resources and typed notes are not permitted.
Headsets, headphones and earphones are not permitted.
Complete the official system check at least 48 hours before the test using the same setup planned for test day.
